caption-position.description: Where the caption sits: `bottom` (default) places it beneath the image; `overlay` positions it absolutely across the bottom of the image on a translucent dark bar.

zoom.description: Clicking the image opens it at full size. Bare attribute.

lightbox.description: Open the image in a lightbox on click. **On by default** — this is opt-OUT, so write `lightbox="false"` to disable it.

caption.description: Caption text. Sets the `<figcaption>` content, creating one if the figure has none.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
